title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your personal account and preferences
workspaceHint: Appearance, app behavior, and connected services.
helpHint: Restart the guided tour whenever you need it.
accountHint: This information applies to you only and is visible to colleagues.
dateOfBirthHint: Only the day and month are ever shown, and only if you turn this on — your birth year always stays private.
editProfileHint: Update the details colleagues see about you.
completenessHint: Add a photo, job title, department and phone number so colleagues can find and reach you.
appPrefsHint: Saved to your account — they follow you across devices.
connectionsHint: Whether your account is linked to the systems that feed your absences and activity.
clockodoDirect: Linked directly — your absences sync automatically.
clockodoViaPerson: Linked via your ActivityTrack record — your absences sync automatically.
clockodoUnlinkedHint: Ask an admin to link your Clockodo account so absences sync.
clockodoMigrationError: Could not migrate the Clockodo link
personUnlinkedHint: No ActivityTrack person record is linked to you yet.
avatarPreviewHint: Your photo is cropped to a square and resized automatically.
passkeysHint: Use a fingerprint, face scan, or device PIN to sign in.
passkeySignInHint: Choose a passkey saved on this device or another nearby device.
addPasskeyHint: Choose a name, then confirm with your device.
renamePasskeyHint: Choose a name that helps you recognize this passkey.
removePasskeyHint: This passkey will no longer be able to sign in.
passkeySignInError: Could not sign in with that passkey
totpHint: Use an app like Google Authenticator or 1Password to generate sign-in codes.
setUpTotpHint: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
totpQrAlt: QR code for authenticator app setup
removeTotpHint: You'll no longer be asked for a code from this app.
totpEnabledHint: An authenticator app is set up on this account.
totpNotEnabled: No authenticator app set up yet.
totpLoadError: Could not load authenticator app status
totpEnrollError: Could not start authenticator app setup
totpCodeError: That code didn't match — check the time on your device
totpRecoveryCodesHint: Each code can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app. Store them somewhere safe — you won't see them again.
securityAlwaysMfaHint: Ask for a verification code every time you sign in, on top of your usual sign-in method. Off by default — most people don't need this.
securityAlwaysMfaPasskeyWarning: You already have a passkey, which is already very strong on its own. Turning this on will ask for a code every time you sign in, even with your passkey — most people don't need this.
securityAlwaysMfaEnabled: MFA will now be required at every sign-in
securityAlwaysMfaDisabled: MFA is no longer required at every sign-in
